items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Rushing was still there, straight ahead.

ctx.x: Was Rushing there all through this?

Rushing was still there, straight ahead. We're going on. Now when we get in Chicago we don't have no one woman, so that's where Savannah Churchill came in to sing just "St. Louis Blues" and Ken Bluett went down on 63rd Street and bought her a dress to just sing "St. Louis Blues" which she could sing out of meter but she looked good. Now we got 9 men on the show and no women. Now you can't do that with people standing in lines. You got 7,000 people in a theatre, you got to have a woman up there. That's when we…
